{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 132], "size": 5.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08}]}], "text": "The white pointed arches in the dusk catch my
eye. Warm lights come on, and a giant
yellow-and-orange striped drum enters the
frame."}

texts.content:
{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 150], "size": 5.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08}]}], "text": "Then it cuts to an overcast day as I slowly

texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 125], "size": 5.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08}]}], "text": "Someone stops to look out at the calm\ngray-green sea, where small boats bob gently\nand a white cruise ship sails slowly past."}
